title: Student Hypothesis Comparison Draft
description: A human-authored comparison draft written over one confirmed student massing, grid, and height hypotheses framework. It carries ordered comparison criteria, one assessment per existing hypothesis, optional non-binding guidance, and at most three clarification questions. The builder only checks coverage, references, and traceability and projects the human text verbatim; it generates no candidate, no criterion, no assessment, and no architectural conclusion, and it selects nothing.

source_massing_grid_height_framework_sha.description: The canonical JSON plus newline SHA-256 of the complete confirmed massing-grid-height framework this draft answers.

criteria.description: Ordered human-authored comparison criteria; the array order is the human's priority order. May be empty; empty criteria can never support a single-candidate recommendation.

candidate_key.description: One hypothesis_id written by the student in the confirmed massing-grid-height draft; every hypothesis keeps exactly one assessment.

applicable_preconditions.description: Human-written preconditions under which this candidate applies; carried verbatim.

advantages.description: Human-written advantages; carried verbatim, never verified by the machine.

costs_or_risks.description: Human-written costs or risks the candidate would carry; carried verbatim, never verified by the machine.

reconsider_when.description: Human-written conditions under which this candidate should not be chosen or must be reconsidered.

criterion_judgments.description: Human-written per-criterion judgments; may be empty. Every criterion_id must exist in criteria.

clarification_questions.description: At most three human-authored questions, carried verbatim; the builder never adds questions.

focus_candidate_keys.description: Zero, one, or several candidate keys the human suggests focusing on. Exactly one becomes recommended_to_consider_first; two or more become a suggested_focus list; zero yields no single suggestion. The machine never resolves a tie.

basis.description: Human-written reasoning for the guidance; carried verbatim.

basis_criterion_ids.description: The ordered criteria this guidance rests on; every id must exist in criteria, otherwise the guidance is untraceable and the draft fails closed.

advantages.description: Human-written advantages of following this guidance.

costs_or_risks.description: Human-written costs or risks of following this guidance.

reconsider_when.description: Human-written conditions under which this guidance should be discarded or overturned.
